welcome.title: Welcome to AILearning
welcome.body: Enter your learning system URL to get started.
welcome.guideStep1: Enter your organization's learning system URL in the field above, including the full http:// or https:// prefix.
welcome.guideStep2: Tap “Connect” to open your organization's learning system inside the app.
welcome.guideStep3: If your organization provides a QR code, tap “Have a QR code?” to scan it instead of typing the URL.
welcome.guideNote: The URL and QR code are provided by your organization or school.

scanner.needCamera: Camera permission is required to scan QR codes.
scanner.hint: Point the camera at the QR code to capture the URL
